details: For finite concept classes; both quantities admit a fixed-order tree-rank formulation.
proof: For a fixed domain order, Ben-David, Kushilevitz, and Mansour identify the optimal mistake count with the rank of the corresponding order-labeled consistency tree. An order-shattered set of size d yields a complete binary subtree of depth d in that tree, so its rank is at least d. Minimize over orders to obtain best mistakes at least the minimum largest order-shattered-set size.
name: Best Mistakes / Minimum Largest Order Shattered Set
